review: This game was very fun for the limited time I could play it, but I haven't been able to launch the game since late last year. Do not buy this, as it will be a waste of money. The anticheat update completely broke the game for most PC players, and even if you can play it then the game is horribly optimized and will stutter/freeze on you in game.

I would like to tell a short story about my experience with this awesome swagalicious game.
At first, the bugs and load speeds were so terrible that i thought I'd never play this game again, but FUT had me logging countless hours. After my 90 hours, my account was hacked, and I contacted support 10+ times in order to get my account back. When i finally got it back, my account was banned because the hacker was using a modified client. Now, needing to contact support again. I was unbanned, but all my players were gone. Everything I acquired was just erased. I had to restart from scratch on FUT and the people at EA told me there was nothing they could do because they don't have jurisdiction in FUT. Even with my experience, the game is already buggy enough; along with using the same animations and menus from 2015. I just uninstalled guys pls dont support these horn glazers at EA.

as a FIFA veteran, who has played multiple games of the same franchise, i would definitely recommend this.

A few things to note:

-Don't buy this game at its original price. Usually, FIFA games are never worth it at their original price, and moreover, they usually go for sale like a month or two later (on Steam atleast, since that's where i bought both 22 and 23 from.). 

-This game would probably intrigue you only if you're into football(even if a little bit), and are willing to take the time to understand the mechanics. Doesn't take very long, provided you have a controller. (imagine playing with a keyboard lol.)

-I would always recommend a controller for the most immersive experience. The game is easy to learn that way, and seems less like mechanical and more fluid in general.

Lastly, if you've played earlier FIFA games, and think this wont be much of an upgrade, then you're somewhat correct. There's a lot more ingame immersive upgrades that I think would only be visible to a person who's played almost all these games, and is willing to take the time to notice. It's still worth it if you ask me, and if not this one, rumours are that the next part of this game is going to be have more significant improvements, since the FIFA partnership is over. 

Still the best football game there is, go play efootball or some other goofy game if you wanna save money lol.
